Touch: left thumb moves · drag anywhere else to look, pinch to zoom · tap to swing your sword that way · the potion button drinks · BAG opens your backpack · USE at shop counters
WASD move · Space jump · Shift dodge roll · ← → turn the camera · Right-drag look · Wheel zoom
Click swing your sword · Q small potion · R big potion · B backpack (equip, open chests) · E shop at a counter · M menu
The kingdom: Grugvale is safe. Each gate leads to a zone with its own monsters, each tougher than the last: Greenwood (level 1), Bogmire (6), Frostpeak (12), the Scorched Dunes (18) and, past the Dunes, Dragon's Maw (25). A gate opens when you reach its level
Gear: monsters drop gold and XP. Buy better swords at the Ironfist Forge and armour at the Iron Bulwark. Each zone has a boss at its far end
Loot chests: monsters drop them now and then (bosses always), or buy them at the Lucky Chest Vault. A chest can hold a sword from the next zone up!
